newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices recover after initial falls.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices recover after initial falls.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices regained the initiative after an opening setback in Wednesday's trade, dealers said.
They said prices gained to 1,170/1,171 rupees per quintal after falling to 1,166 rupees on reports of increased arrivals.
New crop arrivals has begun picking up at producing centres again due to the end of Tuesday's kite festival. Traders expect prices to remain subdued in the next few days.
Groundnut oil fell to 348/349 rupees per 10 kg from 352/353 as seasonal buying eased while stockists were busy booking profit. Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
